title: State-write event payload v0.2 (0ds M1-S1 blackboard state partition)
description: 0ds M1-S1 (2026-10-27, 366 charter / architecture §4.1/§9): an accepted write to the blackboard `state` partition. The payload is a mechanical audit row — which fields the caller provided, a bounded goal preview, the rendered content size and the chars/2 token estimate — plus a self-contained full-text snapshot: `state` carries the complete rendered state document at write time (bounded at 2048 chars; the 200-token design cap keeps the rendered document ≈400 chars). R-M1S1-01 (370 §8.2 step 4, user decision: adopt the snapshot) — replaying accepted rows in journal order reconstructs the state history from this row alone; the corresponding model_output `state_write` / `blackboard_write` tool call remains the provenance record for the write arguments.

then.description: 371 批（F5b，2026-10-28）：accepted 行必有系统盖章（r<round>@<domain> <ts>）。
371 批（F5b）：cleared 行无状态可盖，不携带 updated。

fields.description: Fields provided by this write (fixed order goal/now/next/open/constraints). Absent fields keep their previous value (merge semantics).

goal.description: Bounded goal preview (first non-empty field when goal is absent).

state.description: Full-text snapshot of the rendered state document at write time (first 2048 chars; the 200-token design cap keeps it ≈400). Empty string on `cleared` (post-clear state is empty).

content_chars.description: Rendered state document character count at write time.

estimated_tokens.description: chars/2 estimate of the rendered state document (≤200 by design).
